scope: Fix directional transcript coverage at the existing framework-completed gate. One production file, reusing existing text normalization, revision comparison and event-driven settlement. No EOT threshold, silence timeout, SDK source, dependency, mode-owner or hotword change.
problem: UserTurnCoordinator.framework_completion_readiness used symmetric transcript_revision_matches as a coverage test. A shorter old SDK completion text could therefore certify a longer pending interim after an earlier FINAL, committing the unfinished repetition/extension.
change: Require normalized framework text to be at least as long as the pending text before accepting the existing revision match. Keep the same coordinator lease, evidence notifications and deadline behavior. Final ASR evidence wakes settlement; there is no new timer or polling.

test_setup_failures.issue: New parametrized unit test initially omitted pytest import; collection error, corrected before production changes.

New replay initially omitted ScriptedTranscript.interims, so final=False emitted no interim and wait timed out. Corrected the test input before the valid before/after runs; not counted as product behavior evidence.

observed_before: Three negative unit cases failed coverage assertions; all six valid SDK replays prematurely committed the growing interim and emitted 1920 bytes of reply audio. The two positive coverage checks passed.
observed_after: All eleven new targeted checks passed. In the broader run the six replays had no premature user commit/audio, exactly one complete user message/reply, 722.1-737.5 ms acoustic-stop to reply and 3.9-23.3 ms latest-final to commit.
limits: This repairs a stale-boundary logic error, not the EOT model false positives/negatives. Existing conditional-prefix premature reply remains strict xfail.

When final evidence never arrives, the existing settlement deadline/fallback still applies; this change can make previously premature replies wait for that existing deadline. No claim that all tail latency is resolved.
Interim-only admission remains unchanged; this fix concerns earlier FINAL followed by a longer pending INTERIM.
No real ASR/service or RTC/device/AEC latency acceptance run this phase. No direct mapping to phase13 audio-detector replacement failures is asserted.
PTT behavior and its phase14 cleanup optimization are unchanged and included in regression.
